description: Switch the live deploy's `_redirects` rules off, or back on, without a deploy, for example when a deployed file sends visitors to the wrong place. User rules keep applying either way. The switch lasts until it is turned back on or the next deploy goes live. Visitors get the change within about 5 minutes. Answers `NoFileRules` when the live deploy has no `_redirects`. Confirm with the user before switching the file rules off.

enabled.description: False to stop the file rules, true to apply them again.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

name: switch_file_redirects
